findings.message:
[P2] Advance bound ignores configured target count

`advanceLimit` is `DEFAULT_STEP_LIMIT` plus the pending-intent count, and each new target consumes one advance just to prepare and start. With more configured targets than that limit (33+ in a clean state), `flow.advance` stops returning true and the pass finishes without preparing the remaining targets; because the cursor restarts at zero on every invocation, those targets are never reached and are not even added to `skipped`. Include `input.configs.length` in the bound, for example `Math.max(input.configs.length, DEFAULT_STEP_LIMIT) + intents`.

src/host/matrix-aggregate.ts:329-336

[P3] Frozen test omits changed loop-eligibility source

The new copy loop preserves local changes for `matrix-aggregate.ts`, `actions-target-flow.ts`, `main.ts`, `loop-cycle.ts` and `loop-types.ts`, but omits `src/repair/loop-eligibility.ts`, which `loop-cycle.ts` now imports for `matrixOwnsFreshImplementation`. When the working tree differs from HEAD (the stated purpose of these copies), the frozen child links the new `loop-cycle.ts` against the old `loop-eligibility.ts` and fails to resolve the export; add that file to the list.

tests/host/hosted-runtime-bootstrap_test.ts:49-56

summary: The change implements the requested matrix-owned skip, bounded aggregate advances, and clean-bootstrap compatibility short-circuit, and the added tests measure sentinel_step counts. Two defects remain: the fixed advance bound can permanently omit configured targets beyond 32, and the frozen bootstrap test omits a newly changed source module.

evidence: `src/repair/loop-eligibility.ts` adds `matrixOwnsFreshImplementation`; `src/repair/loop-cycle.ts` skips pristine issue records when external implementations and batched planner branch assignment own them.

`src/host/matrix-aggregate.ts` adds `advanceLimit = DEFAULT_STEP_LIMIT + pending intents` and routes all `flow.advance` calls through it, bounding serial work while native carriers retain a full drain.

`src/host/matrix-aggregate.ts` short-circuits a clean bootstrap with no reserved reservation, intent, or `review_pending` wait to a repair-state compatibility parse and idle result without transport, preparation, or lifecycle work.

`tests/host/matrix-serial-pass_test.ts` measures sentinel_step counts: zero for 700 planner-owned issues across 30 targets, at most 32 for 270 custody records, and the full 270 only for native consumers.
